title: Akhaura Front and Battle of Daruin
subtitle: Eastern-sector fighting shapes the route toward Brahmanbaria and Dhaka.
summary: The Akhaura front, including fighting around Daruin, was part of the eastern-sector campaign in 1971. These engagements pressured Pakistani defenses on routes linking Tripura, Brahmanbaria, and the approach toward Dhaka.
heroTagline: Eastern-sector fighting shapes the route toward Brahmanbaria and Dhaka.
whyItMatters: The event adds an important eastern-front route to the military map of 1971.
